items.raw_excerpt: Lisbon City Hall is handing over the first 60 keys from 132 affordable housing units built in the Marvila district, an investment of about €15 million, the municipality announced.
items.summary_en: Lisbon City Hall handed out the first 60 keys to new affordable housing units. The homes are in the Marvila district of the city. The city spent about 15 million euros to build 132 units in total.
items.summary_ko: 리스본시가 마르빌라 지역에 지은 저렴한 주택 가운데 첫 60채의 열쇠를 전달했습니다. 시는 모두 132채를 짓는 데 약 1500만 유로를 들였습니다. 나머지 주택도 차례로 전달될 예정입니다.
items.title_en: Lisbon gives first keys to new affordable homes

items.raw_excerpt: En esta nueva edición de Energía que Conecta en Cooperativa, conversamos con la académica del Departamento de Física y Química de la Facultad de Ingeniería de la Universidad Autónoma, Romina Muñoz, quien profundizó acerca del proyecto que busca enseñar a vecinos de Maipú a usar sensores para descubrir si sus casas son aptas para generar energía eólica o solar. También explicamos cuál es la diferencia entre el ahorro y la eficiencia energética.
items.summary_en: A Chilean university project teaches people in Maipú to use small sensors. The sensors help them find out if their homes are good for solar or wind energy. The talk also explained the difference between saving energy and using it more efficiently.
items.summary_ko: 칠레의 한 대학 프로젝트가 마이푸 주민들에게 작은 센서 사용법을 가르친다. 이 센서로 자기 집이 태양광이나 풍력 발전에 알맞은지 알아볼 수 있다. 방송에서는 에너지 절약과 에너지 효율의 차이도 함께 설명했다.
items.title_en: Project teaches neighbors to check if their homes can make solar or wind power
items.title_ko: 이웃들이 집에서 태양광이나 풍력 발전이 가능한지 확인하도록 돕는 프로젝트
items.title_original: Energía que Conecta: El proyecto para descubrir hogares aptos para generar solar o eólica

items.raw_excerpt: Mhaule says collective efforts are needed to ensure learners can peacefully write their final exams
items.summary_en: South Africa's education department asked parents to support learners during their final matric exams. It said everyone must work together so students can write their exams in peace. The matric exams are a big moment for many young people.

items.raw_excerpt: Hailing the festive spirit of Dasara in Mysuru, Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar said the celebrations spread over the next 11 days will offer a glimpse of the country’s culture and heritage to people in India and abroad.

items.summary_en: South Africa's education department will appeal a ruling that cleared some learners of group copying. The learners had their matric results held back for almost two years. The department wants the higher court to review the decision.

items.raw_excerpt: Small towns in Ireland, including Dingle, Cobh, Lismore, and Westport, are where castles, trad music pubs, and local festivals shape everyday life.
items.summary_en: A travel roundup looks at small towns in Ireland. Places like Dingle, Cobh, Lismore, and Westport mix castles, music pubs, and local festivals. These towns shape simple everyday life for locals and visitors.

items.raw_excerpt: In the lengthy negotiations that would likely result if Alberta were to secede, at least one chapter would be dedicated to Banff. Would the town on federal parkland be claimed by Alberta? Or would it become a tiny piece of Canada isolated within a new country?
items.summary_en: Banff is a small town in the Rocky Mountains. It sits on federal parkland and leases its land from the federal government. If Alberta separates, Banff could become a tiny piece of Canada inside a new country.
items.summary_ko: 밴프는 로키산맥에 있는 작은 마을이다. 이 마을은 연방 정부의 공원 부지에 있고, 땅을 연방 정부에서 임대한다. 앨버타가 분리되면 밴프는 새 나라 안에 남는 작은 캐나다 땅이 될 수도 있다.
items.title_en: What would happen to Banff if Alberta leaves Canada?
items.title_ko: 앨버타가 분리되면 밴프는 어떻게 될까?
items.title_original: Banff is in Treaty 7 territory and leases its land from the feds. So what happens to it if Alberta separates?
